name: Best Friends
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love and support, especially in times of adversity, as a friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity (Proverbs 17:17). Genuine friends show compassion to the afflicted, reflecting godly fear rather than forsaking it (Job 6:14). Wise companionship leads to wisdom and life, whereas association with fools results in destruction (Proverbs 13:20). Furthermore, friends are preserved through forgiveness and discretion, while strife and gossip can sever even close relationships (Proverbs 16:28; 17:9).
